an5.68:1.1: bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto 'va samāno pañca dhamme bhāvesiṃ pañca dhamme bahuli-m-akāsiṃ.
an5.68:1.8: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ ussoḷhipañcamānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā yassa yassābhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ abhiññāsacchikiriyāya,
an5.68:1.9: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
an5.68:2.1: So sace ākaṅkhiṃ: anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ . . . pe . . . yāva Brahmalokā pi kāyena 'va saṃvatteyyan ti,
an5.68:2.2: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
an5.68:3.1: So sace ākaṅkhiṃ: . . . pe . . . āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan ti,
an5.68:3.2: tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane
